description: v0.1.6 gate (docs/188 §6): Apex Radiance with its saved settings plus the hotfix pair (ts3native 0.36.37a, [Compat] ApexStandDown=1 as released) loads the Apex test town, lets lots load and Sims route, then save, save, reload, save. Pass: every save completes without Error 12, the reload reaches live mode, no crash; our ts3native.log copy (load-<n>-with-ts3native.log) has 3 'save: end #N result 0' lines (#1, #2 before the reload, #3 after it), no 'save: still running after' >= 120 s, no FAIL line and the 'ts3fixes: ts3fixes 0.1.6' line (the hotfix package is the installed one).
